cards.def: to live or last longer than someone or something else.
ex: She outlived her husband by nearly twenty years.
The old software has long outlived its usefulness.

cards.def: A soldier trained to jump from aircraft using a parachute.
ex: Her grandfather was a former paratrooper who served overseas for years.
The paratrooper landed safely in the open field at dawn.

cards.def: To move with high, lively steps; to walk in a proud way.
ex: The excited children pranced around the yard in their new costumes.
The nervous horse pranced restlessly before the starting gate.

cards.def: Arriving or doing something at the exact time arranged.
ex: She is always punctual and never misses a morning meeting.
The manager praised his punctual arrival every single day.

cards.def: the process of breathing air in and out of the lungs.
ex: The lifeguard performed artificial respiration on the swimmer.
The nurse recorded the patient's respiration rate every hour.

cards.def: equipment that lets a diver breathe underwater.
ex: He learned to scuba dive on vacation in Thailand.
All the scuba gear is stored in the shed by the dock.

cards.def: the meat of an adult sheep, used as food
ex: They served roast mutton with potatoes at the family dinner.
The butcher prepared a leg of mutton for the holiday meal.

cards.def: a tool with a long curved blade used for cutting grass or crops by hand
ex: The farmer swung his scythe through the wheat.
They cut the tall grass with a scythe.
